items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: He actually put me on as Associate Principal when I went with the orchestra, with that City Central Symphony when I went with him.

ctx.x: Something like that. And what’s her name, Billie Holiday was in the picture as well. And I was working at Condon’s at the time. And Ernie Anderson thought it would be a marvelous idea for Louis to have the All Stars. That’s when that concept came up. And Ernie was very much behind that thing. Louis was managed by Joe Glaser for the years. He owned him as a matter of fact. It’s an awful term but it was a fact. And he had talked

him into trying that. And they wanted me — Arvell Shaw was working with Louis’ band. Louis had a big band in those days. And this was during the days when I was still connected with Eddie Condon a lot. But I was pretty busy with the studios and the jobs — they were going out for a tour, they had fixed up a tour to try it I think. Ernie finally got I think Earl Hines and Louis and oh I’m not too sure, Edmond Hall was on it with me when I went later on, and Barney Bigard and Velma Middleton. I think they fixed up…
Was there a jazz scene in Australia?
